findings.body: The previously reported gap remains: legitimate progress with done=0 and total=0 fails this validator. src/forge/review.py:301–305 accepts zero-item pytest collection, and lines 311–332 publish zero-length TAP progress. This rejects the entire Machine refresh and also prevents confirmed stops while that snapshot persists. Accept zero totals and display elapsed time without a bar, guarding label() against division by zero.
findings.title: Accept zero-test progress without rejecting the entire snapshot

findings.body: The previously reported gap remains: a run can finish after the fresh lanes read but before stop executes. src/forge/machine.py:286–287 then returns zero with "There is nothing to stop.", but this line discards that outcome and displays "Run stopped." Preserve the command's no-target result and show the ended/replaced message with its next action. Existing stale-target tests remove the entry before the fresh read, so they do not exercise this window.
findings.title: Preserve the stop command's no-target outcome

stop.reason: Owner accepts: the spinner's place-in-line ships as a separate small fix next; the extra drawing-test coverage is dismissed per the one-test-per-rule direction.
